assign.request: A task page shows history and a report but never says where the task is right now — add the current-status line, above the fold, from m.now (card.js:24 already reads it). Landed tasks: prefer nothing over a stale now. No-now tasks: nothing, not a placeholder. Don't duplicate the checklist. AITask.js budget ~15 lines growth.

assign.now: verifying: live task, a landed task, a no-now task — 3 screenshots at 1280

log.msg: Implemented: card.js exports `current` (unchanged logic), AITask.js gets a `status(m)` method called first inside refresh() (so it redraws on live streamed updates, not just first paint). Rule: !landed_at && current(m), suppressed if it equals the checklist step name (mirrors card.js dedup). No new CSS — reuses ai-dot/live + flex gap v-center utilities. AITask.js: 179 -> 193 lines (+14, within budget).

Playwright cross-check first found dolLine leaking the PARENT task-status page's own `now` into a nested fixture — turned out the DOM keeps ancestor .active-ancestor pages mounted (nested-catalog nav), so an unscoped querySelector(".ai-live") grabs the first match, not the visible one. Rescoped to `.page.active-page .ai-live` and the bleed-through vanished. Not a defect in status() itself, but a real trap for anyone eval-testing this page.

Verified all three states, 1280 wide, zero console errors each: (1) live — /framework/ai/2026-08-16/mastermind-layout/ shows the pulsing dot + its latest `now` (22nd now line, current) above STEPS. (2) landed — /framework/ai/2026-08-17/ai-card-mobile/ (landed_at set, last now was literally the word "landing") shows nothing: checklist head is the first thing after the brief. (3) no-now — a throwaway fixture at task-status/_verify-no-now/ (page.js + task.jsonl with no `now` key, deleted immediately after this check) also shows nothing. Screenshots logged as shot lines below.

Noticed one stray auto-logged action line in this file for report-full/requirements.md — not a file this task touched. Cross-session hook attribution; the ledger-attribution task already owns that. Not investigated further here.

assign.outcome:
**Task pages now say where they are.** `AITask.status(m)` (`ext/AITask/AITask.js`, +14 lines) reads the same `now` `card.js` already put on the board — exported instead of re-derived — and renders above the checklist, called first inside `refresh()` so a running task's streamed `now` lines replace it in place, not just at first paint. Silent once `landed_at` is set (a stale `now` would contradict the `outcome` right below it) and silent when the manifest never wrote a `now` at all — nothing beats a wrong answer either way. Also silent when `now` repeats the checklist's own current step, matching the card's existing dedup. No new CSS — reuses `ai-dot`/`live` and `flex gap v-center`.

Verified against three real states at 1280, zero console errors each (screenshots logged above): **[live](/framework/ai/2026-08-16/mastermind-layout/)** — still running, read it now and it reads current; **[landed](/framework/ai/2026-08-17/ai-card-mobile/)** — last `now` was literally the word "landing", shows nothing; **no-`now`** — a throwaway fixture (page.js + task.jsonl, no `now` key) built, screenshotted, then deleted before landing.

Docs updated: `readme.md`, `doc/template.md` (the `report()` outline), `page.js`'s `methods:` + new `doc/method/status.md`.

One real trap found verifying: this nested-catalog nav keeps an ancestor task page mounted (hidden) behind its child, so an eval script querying `.ai-live` unscoped reads the PARENT's `now`, not the visible page's — scope to `.page.active-page .ai-live`. Logged, not fixed anywhere (a test-script gotcha, not a site bug).

Left alone, per the brief: `assign.now`'s meaning and the log format.
